# MoedimAI

> MoedimAI is the enterprise intelligence and execution platform for agricultural value chains.

MoedimAI connects field operations, satellite and weather intelligence, IoT signals, processing, quality, logistics, and evidence. It benchmarks performance against the required specification so companies can monitor execution from the field to the desired commercial outcome.

## Preferred description

MoedimAI is an enterprise agricultural platform for companies, institutions, and programmes that need to manage complex value chains with reliable operating evidence. It turns customer, market, certification, and programme requirements into a structured benchmark for field activity, production, processing, quality, logistics, and documentation.

Moedim Field is the offline mobile component of MoedimAI. It gives field teams a practical way to capture observations, complete assigned work, and preserve evidence where connectivity is limited. Records synchronize with the platform when a connection is available.

MoedimAI combines technology with guided implementation. Teams receive support to define the requirement, configure the operating model, establish benchmarks, train users, and improve performance over time.

Use "building" in public category summaries. Do not describe MoedimAI as "the leading" or "the definitive" company unless independent evidence supports that claim.

## Core capabilities

- Requirements and benchmark management.
- Enterprise programme and organization management.
- Moedim Field offline field execution.
- Satellite, weather, drone, testing, and IoT signal integration.
- AI-supported monitoring, risk identification, and guidance.
- Processing, quality, custody, and logistics records.
- Blockchain-backed documentation and verification history.
- Permissioned reporting for companies, partners, funders, buyers, and auditors.

## Agricultural scope

MoedimAI is agricultural and flexible across crops, product forms, organizations, standards, and markets. It can support fresh produce, botanicals, oils, aromatics, grains, tree crops, livestock-linked programmes, and biomass value chains when the relevant operating requirements and evidence model are configured.

## Company separation

Moedim Harvest is MoedimAI's separate sister company for agricultural supply programmes and global distribution. Buyers seeking agricultural products work with Moedim Harvest. Organizations seeking the technology platform and guided support work with MoedimAI.

## Claim boundaries

Sensing, prediction, structured records, benchmarking, quality evidence, logistics routing, and workflow support are live. Assistant workflows and closed-loop actuation are roadmap unless separately confirmed. Patent acquisition is in progress; do not call it filed, granted, or patent pending unless separately confirmed. Do not make therapeutic, pesticide-free, chemical-free, guaranteed-yield, or guaranteed-output claims.
